content.rendered:
We are eagerly making plans for our students to return for the new school year. We anticipate it’s going to be a great year!

Please read our first Middleton Update HERE for upcoming dates, school schedule and more information needed to start the year off. And for our new Kindergarten families click HERE for specific dates and times for all kindergartners.

As always if you have additional questions please call our office at 503-825-5302.

We look forward to seeing you soon.
